paper_id: SkinGEN_ an Explainable Dermatology Diagnosis-to-Generation Framework with Interactive Vision-Language Models
title: SkinGEN: an Explainable Dermatology Diagnosis-to-Generation Framework with Interactive Vision-Language Models
motivation: 用户难以信任VLM的黑盒诊断结果，且皮肤病症状相似难以区分，现有工具缺乏视觉解释能力
problem_framing: 将诊断黑箱问题转化为视觉可解释性问题——通过生成相似病情的可视化参考图像来增强用户理解
key_insight: 用Stable Diffusion从诊断结果生成参考演示图像，让用户通过视觉对比自行理解病情，而非依赖LLM的文本解释
method_signature: VLM诊断+LoRA/IP-Adapter双适配器融合生成可视化病情图谱
evaluation_criteria: 用户研究的信任度、易理解度、认知负担评分，以及生成图像的CLIP/DINOv2/MSE指标
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 微调IP-Adapter效果最差，存在过拟合问题；扩大数据集反而导致CLIP/DINOv2下降；用户反馈建议过于简单(全说去看医生)；相似疾病难以区分
evidence_for_taste: vision, as an intuitive and easily understandable mode of expression
Solely focusing on a model's predicted diagnosis lacks visual interpretation
users often find it difficult to trust the diagnostic results
the diagnosis of certain dermatological conditions is more challenging
the fine-tuned Ip-adapter (30-shot) produced the least desirable results
suggesting potential challenges related to overfitting or optimization
scaling to the full Fitzpatrick17k dataset degrades CLIP
these results highlight inconsistencies in the benefits
the suggestions given by SkinGEN are too simple
for other more similar diseases, I think it is more of a reference
thinking_moves: 将黑盒诊断问题重新frame为视觉可解释性问题
从模型能力转向用户体验——用图像生成解决信任危机
通过用户访谈发现LLM幻觉痛点，强调视觉演示赋予用户主动判断能力
承认扩大数据反而降低性能，重新审视过拟合问题
从单一适配器转向双适配器融合策略
